DP Black Star Promos

Released May 1, 2007 · 56 cards

DP Black Star Promos is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Diamond & Pearl series, released in English on May 1, 2007. It has 56 cards. It includes 51 Pokémon, 5 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

16 illustrators worked on DP Black Star Promos. Most cards: Shizurow (12), Kagemaru Himeno (8), Ryo Ueda (7), Mitsuhiro Arita (5), Sumiyoshi Kizuki (4), Daisuke Ito (3), Wataru Kawahara (3), Atsuko Nishida (2).
